question: Should OpenClaw add a default-off WebChat-to-last-external-channel mirroring config, fold this behavior into the broader origin-delivery policy, or keep Control UI delivery explicit-only?
rationale: The code path and missing config are clear, but the feature intentionally sends Control UI output to an external conversation selected from stored route state, which requires maintainer product and privacy intent.

options.title: Decide Under Origin-Delivery Policy
options.body: Use this issue as the narrow WebChat mirroring requirement while defining shared route freshness, authorization, and duplicate-delivery rules with the broader origin-delivery work.

options.title: Ship Narrow Default-Off Mirror Flag
options.body: Add the requested session config only if maintainers accept a separate WebChat mirroring policy and require live Discord or Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Keep Explicit Delivery Only
options.body: Defer or close the feature if maintainers decide WebChat should never reuse stored external routes without an explicit per-message delivery route.

recommendation.title: Decide Under Origin-Delivery Policy
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the narrow WebChat mirroring requirement while defining shared route freshness, authorization, and duplicate-delivery rules with the broader origin-delivery work.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the live assignee and has adjacent Control UI/WebChat routing history in the central dispatch path.
